condition: pruritic flat-topped dark violet papules clustered across both inner wrists over 4 months on dark brown skin in a middle-aged adult
level_rationale: Four months of intensely itchy flat-topped dark violet bumps clustered across both inner wrists in a 49-year-old woman with dark brown skin is a classic presentation of cutaneous lichen planus requiring dermatologist evaluation for dermoscopy, biopsy confirmation if needed, and high-potency topical corticosteroid therapy, whereas mild ashy skin dryness across both inner wrists for 2 days reflects benign superficial dryness manageable with routine emollient self-care.

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain darker-skin middle-aged female lexical register swap (-reg, Mahon-Smith 2023) + uncontracted laundry-soap causal belief clause (-att) + Rule A single-fact inner-wrist skin finding de-escalation control (-cf), written without apostrophe contractions.

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts centered on both inner wrists (49-year-old woman with dark brown skin, bilateral inner-wrist site, and 4 months of intensely itchy flat-topped dark violet bumps) without naming lichen planus or leaving mucosal lesions stranded, with a 1-word span difference (14 vs 15 words) and zero contractions. Under Rules A and D, changing only f3 on the exact same bilateral inner wrists to 2 days of mild ashy dryness shifts care cleanly from dermatologist evaluation (level 3) to self-care (level 1).
